title: Sand Drops
description: Makes Husks and Parched drop sand blocks
body:
Makes Husks and Parched drop sand blocks


Drop chances:
| Looting Level | Quantity Range | Drop Chance | Average |
| ------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ------- |
| None          | 0–1            | 50.00%      | 0.50    |
| Looting I     | 0–2            | 75.00%      | 1.00    |
| Looting II    | 0–3            | 87.50%      | 1.50    |
| Looting III   | 0–4            | 91.67%      | 2.00    |
